verdict.rationale: USPTO's own docs show per-document retrieval of filing records: TSDR exposes application documents, Patent Center lets registered users view their submissions, uncertified patent copies can be downloaded, and DOCX filings are converted to TIFF. Nothing documents an account-wide bulk export or leaving with all your data, and the API's machine docs could not be read without a key. Missing for 10: a documented full-account or bulk export of all user data, explicit open export formats, documented export via API, and independent or hands-on confirmation.
